agent acas.summary: List the AI coding agents new agents can run

agent attach.summary: Show an agent full-window and talk to it, as tmux does

agent create.summary: Create an agent and start its AI coding agent

agent models.summary: List the models agent create --model takes

agent rename.summary: Give an agent a new name

agent restart.summary: Start an agent again in a new session, which reads its history in brief

agent send.summary: Give a running agent a message, submitted once it can take it

agent start.summary: Start an agent that exited, failed or was lost, in the same session

agent transcript.summary: Print an agent's conversation as text

daemon restart.summary: Restart the daemon, or start it

daemon status.summary: Show whether the daemon is running

deps install.summary: Install a dependency with the system's package manager

deps list.summary: List the programs wdx needs, whether each is ready, and what it enables

doc create.summary: Create a doc, from a file or empty

doc get.summary: Print a doc's content, or write it to a file to change

doc remove.summary: Delete a doc and all its revisions

doc set.summary: Change a doc's folder, status or labels

doc sync-to-git.summary: Write a project's docs, read-only, into a directory of its repository

doc update.summary: Write a doc's content as a new revision

message list.summary: List a project's messages still waiting, oldest first

message resend.summary: Send a message still waiting to its terminal or agent, as it is now

observe start.summary: Start Grafana with the logs and metrics

plan archive.summary: Archive a done or cancelled plan, leaving it out of plan list

plan cancel.summary: Cancel a running or paused plan: its agents stop, and it cannot run again

plan copy.summary: Create a draft from a plan's latest revision, to run again or start from

plan create.summary: Create a plan from its YAML

plan get.summary: Print a plan's YAML, or write it to a file to change

plan pause.summary: Pause a running plan: nothing new starts, and tasks at work go on and land

plan remove.summary: Delete a plan and all its revisions

plan resume.summary: Resume a paused plan, which starts what its pause held back

plan run.summary: Run a draft plan: an agent for each task, landing on the plan's branch

plan set.summary: Change a plan's folder, or how many tasks a running or paused plan runs at once

plan status.summary: Show what a plan defines and how its run goes: its goal, and its tasks or plans in DAG order

plan task done.summary: Say a task of a running plan is done, so that it lands on the plan's branch

plan task get.summary: Show a plan's task: its state, agent and worktree, prompt and summary

plan task land.summary: Land a land_failed task again, once you dealt with what stopped it

plan task retry.summary: Run a failed or land_failed task again, keeping its worktree and commits

plan task skip.summary: Skip a pending, failed or land_failed task: what waits for it goes on without it

plan unarchive.summary: Show an archived plan in plan list again

plan update.summary: Write a plan's YAML as a new revision

project create.summary: Create a project in a new git repository

project get.summary: Show a project, which of its checkouts are on disk and its terminals

project landing.summary: Show or say how a project lands its worktrees

project open.summary: Open a project: a known one, a local repository or a clone

project remove.summary: Delete a project and everything that belongs to it

setting list.summary: List every setting with its value

setting set.summary: Change a setting and apply it at once

setting write.summary: Write the config file anew, listing every setting of this version

terminal attach.summary: Show a terminal full-window and type into it, as tmux does

terminal create.summary: Create a terminal and start its shell

terminal history.summary: Print the lines that scrolled off a terminal's screen

terminal send.summary: Type a message into a running terminal and press Enter

terminal start.summary: Start a fresh shell for a terminal that exited, failed or was lost

tide.summary: Work in the terminal IDE: a project, an agent and terminals in one window

update.summary: Show whether a newer wdx is released, install it or roll it back

version.summary: Print the version of wdx and of the daemon

worktree comments.summary: List the comments left on a worktree's diffs

worktree diff.summary: Show what a worktree has committed, or what it has not

worktree land.summary: Land a worktree's commits on its base, with no merge commit or through a PR

worktree list.summary: List every worktree git lists for a project, with its changes

worktree rebase.summary: Rebase a worktree onto its base, the default branch or a stacked plan's plan below

worktree remove.summary: Remove a worktree that landed, with its branch
